title: Identification of novel HIF2alpha inhibitors: a structure-based virtual screening approach.
authors: Zhou, Shasha; Yin, Shengnan; Yang, Shudan; Wang, Yuting; Feng, Panfeng
journal: Journal of enzyme inhibition and medicinal chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文通过虚拟筛选和分子动力学模拟寻找HIF2alpha小分子抑制剂，对象为蛋白-小分子互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: HIF2alpha is aberrantly upregulated in some renal cell carcinomas due to VHL mutations, supporting HIF2alpha inhibition as a compelling therapeutic approach for such cases. Therefore, the six compounds (designated as Compounds 1-6) were screened from the Maybridge database based on the constructed pharmacophore model and molecular docking. Subsequently, the docking models of Compounds 1-6 with HIF2alpha were analysed. Affinity assays revealed that both Compound-4 and Compound-5 exhibited robust affinity towards human recombinant HIF2alpha. MD simulations displayed that Compound-4 and Compound-5 stably bound to the active pocket of HIF2alpha. Cell experiments demonstrated that Compound-4 effectively inhibited the growth of the 786-O human renal cell carcinomas line (IC(50) = 1.35 +/- 0.06 muM). This study demonstrates that Compound-4 may serve as a potential candidate compound for renal cell carcinomas therapy.
abstract_zh: 由于VHL突变，HIF2alpha在某些肾细胞癌中异常上调，支持将HIF2alpha抑制作为此类病例的一种有吸引力的治疗策略。因此，基于构建的药效团模型和分子对接，从Maybridge数据库中筛选出六种化合物（命名为化合物1-6）。随后，分析了化合物1-6与HIF2alpha的对接模型。亲和力测定显示，化合物4和化合物5均对人重组HIF2alpha表现出强亲和力。分子动力学（MD）模拟显示，化合物4和化合物5稳定结合于HIF2alpha的活性口袋。细胞实验表明，化合物4有效抑制了786-O人肾细胞癌细胞系的生长（IC(50) = 1.35 ± 0.06 μM）。本研究证明，化合物4可能作为肾细胞癌治疗的潜在候选化合物。
